options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Final Zone unlocks when?
options.doc:
Control when Final Zone can unlock, wait until all other victory conditions are met?

- **Anytime:** You can do Final Zone as soon as you have the key.
- **Last But Optional:** If your victory conditions can be achieved without beating Final Zone you skip it.
- **Always Last:** Final Zone unlocks once you have every other victory condition, beat it to win.

Note that this may change how certain mechanics behave:

- "Always Last" essentially forces the boss goal to be at least 1, "Last But Optional" will not.
- Both "Always Last" and "Last But Optional" will add the Final Zone key to your starting inventory.
- "Always Last" and "Last But Optional" are identical with 6 bosses.
- An example of less than 6: "Always Last" with 3 bosses will require any 2 of the Act 3 bosses then FZ, "Last But Optional" requires any 2 of the Act 3 bosses then either FZ or a third Act 3 boss.
options.doc_html:
Control when Final Zone can unlock, wait until all other victory conditions are met?

  • Anytime: You can do Final Zone as soon as you have the key.
  • Last But Optional: If your victory conditions can be achieved without beating Final Zone you skip it.
  • Always Last: Final Zone unlocks once you have every other victory condition, beat it to win.

Note that this may change how certain mechanics behave:

  • "Always Last" essentially forces the boss goal to be at least 1, "Last But Optional" will not.
  • Both "Always Last" and "Last But Optional" will add the Final Zone key to your starting inventory.
  • "Always Last" and "Last But Optional" are identical with 6 bosses.
  • An example of less than 6: "Always Last" with 3 bosses will require any 2 of the Act 3 bosses then FZ, "Last But Optional" requires any 2 of the Act 3 bosses then either FZ or a third Act 3 boss.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle lorsque la zone finale peut déverrouiller, attendre que toutes les autres conditions de victoire soient remplies?

- **Anytime:** Vous pouvez faire la zone finale dès que vous avez la clé.
- **Last But Optional:** Si vos conditions de victoire peuvent être atteintes sans battre la zone finale, vous la sautez.
- **Always Last:** Zone finale débloque une fois que vous avez toutes les autres conditions de victoire, battre pour gagner.

Notez que cela peut changer le comportement de certains mécaniciens:

- « Toujours last » force essentiellement le but du patron à être au moins 1, « Last But Facultative » ne le fera pas.
- « Toujours last » et « Last But Facultative » ajouteront la touche Zone Finale à votre inventaire de départ.
- "Always Last" et "Last But Facultative" sont identiques à 6 patrons.
- Un exemple de moins de 6: "Toujours dernier" avec 3 patrons exigera un 2 de la loi 3 patrons puis FZ, "Last But Facultative" exige un 2 de la loi 3 patrons puis soit FZ ou un troisième patron Act 3.
